entries.title: Create job details as you go
entries.description: Search for or create a customer, farm and work type directly when creating a job.

entries.title: Find job status and machine choices more easily
entries.description: Job status now appears prominently in the header. Machine and implement choices show category icons to help you identify them.

entries.title: Find jobs by customer and farm
entries.description: Job list rows now lead with the customer and farm and show coloured status labels for easier scanning.

entries.title: Plan a machine without recording its arrival
entries.description: Use the plus action in a job's Machines section to search for a machine, implement and driver. Adding a machine while online now returns you to the job without requiring an arrival capture.

entries.title: Search for implement and driver changes during capture
entries.description: Capture screens now provide searchable selectors for implement and driver overrides.
